queries.query: MATCH (cr:CR) WHERE cr.sourceAuthoredClausesAffected IS NOT NULL RETURN cr.iri AS iri,cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,cr.clausesAffected AS frozenClausesAffected,cr.sourceAuthoredClausesAffected AS sourceAuthoredClausesAffected
queries.SQL: SELECT ni.iri AS iri,cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,cr.clausesAffected AS frozenClausesAffected,cr.sourceAuthoredClausesAffected AS sourceAuthoredClausesAffected FROM CR cr JOIN node_identity ni USING(node_id) WHERE cr.sourceAuthoredClausesAffected IS NOT NULL

queries.name: RAN2_P3_CQ4-3
queries.query:
MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)
WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected) <> ''
  AND cr.sourceAuthoredClausesAffected IS NOT NULL
MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec)
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(target:Release)
MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
WHERE rk.specRelease = target.releaseName
WITH DISTINCT r, cr, rk, cr.sourceAuthoredClausesAffected AS declaredField
UNWIND split(replace(replace(declaredField, ';', ','), '\n', ','), ',') AS declaredItem
WITH r, cr, rk, trim(replace(declaredItem, '\t', ' ')) AS item
WITH r, cr, rk, split(split(item, ' ')[0], '(')[0] AS atom
WITH r, cr, rk, CASE WHEN atom ENDS WITH '.' THEN substring(atom, 0, size(atom)-1) ELSE atom END AS clauseNumber
WHERE clauseNumber =~ '[0-9][A-Za-z0-9]*(?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*|[A-Z](?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*'
MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(rk)
WHERE s.sectionNumber = clauseNumber
RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, s.sectionId AS sectionId
ORDER BY resolutionId, tdocNumber, sectionId
queries.SQL:
SELECT DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId,cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,s.sectionId AS sectionId
        FROM rel_REFERENCES rf JOIN Resolution r ON r.node_id=rf.src_id JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=rf.dst_id
        JOIN rel_MODIFIES md ON md.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=md.dst_id
        JOIN rel_TARGET_RELEASE tr ON tr.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Release target ON target.node_id=tr.dst_id
        JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ri ON ri.dst_id=hub.node_id JOIN Spec rk ON rk.node_id=ri.src_id AND rk.specRelease=target.releaseName
        JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC owner ON owner.dst_id=rk.node_id JOIN Section s ON s.node_id=owner.src_id
        JOIN json_each(AUTHORED_ORDINALS(cr.sourceAuthoredClausesAffected)) item ON s.sectionNumber=item.value
        WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected)<>''
        AND cr.sourceAuthoredClausesAffected IS NOT NULL
